reason: Both prior findings are resolved. C06 now asserts an empty request log across the filter switches. After one polling interval it asserts exactly one entry, GET /api/v1/sessions/A/ledger, so a request to a wrong session or endpoint would fail. C08 now maps keyboard RED/GREEN to the real-Chromium C07 run. Before implementation, the accessible-control assertion fails because the controls are absent. After implementation, the same locked test runs the Tab, Enter, Space and same-node focus assertions. Vitest covers native button semantics and selected state. The other required behavior has observable, discriminating coverage: category membership and overlap, non-ascending order, empty versus filtered-empty states, same-session refresh with stale summaries, and per-commit session reset with recorder calibration. Browser contrast, focus-indicator and style-baseline checks are also covered. This is a design review only; no execution pass is claimed.
